primitives.name: Strategic Sensory Alignment
primitives.verbatim_quote: This feeling localizes itself with most decided difference in regard to the various senseorgans according as we wish to discriminate a thing delicately by touch, taste, or smell.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F': '\\text{Force vector field, N/m}^2', 'S': '\\text{Sensory organ index, dimensionless}', 'd': '\\text{Localization distance, m}'}
primitives.assumptions: Strain localization is proportional to sensory resolution and inverse of spatial spread.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( d \to 0 \), \( F \to \infty \); sensory alignment fails under extreme focus.

layer2.mapping: Cognitive strain \( \mathbf{F} \) is isomorphic to neural activation field over \( S \) with \( \nabla \cdot \mathbf{F} = \rho_{\text{effort}} \).
layer2.telemetry: Muscle tension in scalp and head regions during focused perception.

primitives.name: Memory Recall Analogous Feel
primitives.verbatim_quote: But now I have, when I try to vividly recall a picture of memory or fancy, a feeling perfectly analogous to that which I experience when I seek to grasp a thing keenly by eye or ear ; and this analogous feeling is very differently localized.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F_{\\text{recall}}': '\\text{Recall strain field, N/m}^2', 'F_{\\text{real}}': '\\text{Real object strain field, N/m}^2', 'L': '\\text{Localization shift, m}'}
primitives.assumptions: Recall strain is a shifted version of real-object strain field, \( F_{\text{recall}} = F_{\text{real}} + L \).
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( L \to \infty \), recall becomes dissociated from sensory origin.

layer2.mapping: Recall strain \( F_{\text{recall}} \) derived from \( F_{\text{real}} \) via \( L \) shift kernel; modeled as \( \mathcal{K}(\cdot) \) convolution.
layer2.telemetry: Subjective localization shift in recall vs. real perception.
